description: This file defines the class 'searchCommands' responsible for executing various search and filtering operations within the TestLink testing management system. It manages search parameters, initializes environment, interacts with database tables, and provides methods to search test cases, test suites, requirements, and other entities based on various criteria.

classes.name: searchCommands
classes.description: Encapsulates search operations for test entities, manages search parameters, initializes environment, and provides methods to perform complex searches within the TestLink system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes class properties and database managers.

methods.name: isReqFeatureEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the requirement feature is enabled for a specific test project.

methods.name: getTestCaseIDSet
methods.description: Retrieves the set of test case IDs for a given test project.

methods.name: getTestSuiteIDSet
methods.description: Retrieves the set of test suite IDs for a given test project, excluding specific nodes.

methods.name: getReqSpecIDSet
methods.description: Retrieves requirement specification IDs for a test project.

methods.name: getReqIDSet
methods.description: Retrieves requirement IDs for a test project.

methods.name: getArgs
methods.description: Returns the search arguments/data object.

methods.name: getGui
methods.description: Returns the GUI data object for rendering search interface.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns the search filters.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Returns database table names used in search queries.

methods.name: getViews
methods.description: Returns database view names used in search queries.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Initializes environment for search, including arguments, GUI, and search setup.

methods.name: initSchema
methods.description: Initializes database table and view schemas used in search.

methods.name: initArgs
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes the search arguments.

methods.name: initGui
methods.description: Initializes the GUI representation for search interface.

methods.name: initSearch
methods.description: Sets up the search environment, such as linked custom fields and filtering options.

methods.name: searchReqSpec
methods.description: Performs search on requirement specifications based on target set and access permissions.

methods.name: searchReq
methods.description: Performs search on requirements with filtering based on target set and custom fields.

methods.name: searchTestSuites
methods.description: Searches test suites based on keywords and target filters.

methods.name: searchTestCases
methods.description: Performs complex search on test cases, including filtering by steps, expected results, keywords, and custom fields.

methods.name: getTestCaseWKFStatusDomain
methods.description: Returns a domain (mapping) of test case workflow statuses for filtering.
